expectations.text: Correctly diagnoses that cub unit apply --revision does NOT move head
expectations.evidence: Correctly identifies: 'deployed revision 5 but didn't update the Unit's current version pointer.'

expectations.text: States the doctrinal rule: cub unit apply --revision is NOT a rollback
expectations.evidence: Partially understands the problem but still proposes 'cub unit apply --revision 5 --force' as an alternative — doubling down on the anti-pattern with a non-existent flag.

expectations.text: Uses cub unit update --restore <target> as the correct rollback
expectations.evidence: Does not know about --restore. Proposes exporting revision data to a file and piping into cub unit update.

expectations.text: Explains --restore creates a NEW head revision (not modifying existing ones)
expectations.evidence: No mention of --restore or its behavior.

expectations.text: Shows that subsequent mutations branch from the restored head
expectations.evidence: No discussion of what happens to subsequent mutations.

expectations.text: Mentions named restore targets (Tag:, Before:ChangeSet:, relative)
Includes --change-desc on the restore with proper format
Optionally tags the rollback for future reference
